text.팀 구성을 실행하고 진행·결과를 기록하며 끊긴 실행을 이어 간다: Runs teams, records progress and results, and resumes interrupted runs
Execution backend account sign-in (started and finished on the app screen).
text.실행 백엔드 계정 로그인·로그아웃을 앱 화면에서 할 수 있게 한다. 끄면: Lets you sign in to and out of execution backend accounts from the app screen. When off, those buttons and routes go away (sign-in information from the terminal is still used).
Turn this off so the app never starts a sign-in process on this PC.
Default time to wait for one sign-in. After it, the sign-in stops and asks you to try again.
Stops at this time even if the screen asks for longer.
text.로그인 창이 이 시간 넘게 상태를 묻지 않으면(창을 닫음 등) 로그인을: If the sign-in window doesn't ask for the status for longer than this (for example it was closed), the sign-in is canceled.
How long a finished sign-in result can be viewed again.
Number of last lines of the sign-in process output shown for troubleshooting.
Limit on the number of nodes run at the same time. Leave empty for no limit.
Lower this when the computer slows down or to save usage.
How long to wait for nodes to finish on their own after a cancel.
Number of events that can be queued for each run event receiver.
text.서버 종료 때 실행 중인 작업 정리를 기다리는 최대 시간(넘으면 강제 취: Maximum time to wait for running work to clean up when the server stops (force-canceled after it).
What to do when the projects feature is on but the projects and runs integration is off.
text.막기 = 프로젝트를 붙인 실행·대화를 시작하지 않는다(프로젝트 폴더 밖에: Block = runs and chats with a project don't start (so they don't run outside the project folder). Allow = they run without the project folder or checks.
Switch to allow in setups that use projects only as labels, without the runs integration.
The projects and runs integration is off, so the run wasn't started in the project. Turn on the integration to run with the project folder and its configuration.
Error text of blocked runs, also used as the server info warning text.
Run engine limits such as concurrency, cancel wait and shutdown wait.
text.실행 방식 id → 그 실행 방식이 받는 설치 옵션(키는 실행 방식이 정: Execution backend id → the install options that backend takes (the backend defines the keys).
text.개발·테스트용으로 숨겨 둔 실행 방식(예: 가짜 에이전트)을 선택지와 설: Shows execution backends hidden for development and testing (for example the fake agent) in choices and settings cards. Even when off, definitions that already use them still run.
text.테스트·e2e·화면 개발에서 모델을 부르지 않는 실행 방식을 고를 때 켭: Turn this on to pick a backend that doesn't call a model for tests, e2e or screen development.
text.에이전트가 파일을 읽고 쓰는 폴더. 상대 경로는 설정 파일 폴더 기준,: Folder where agents read and write files. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder; empty means that folder.
Use this when agents work in another project folder.
text.실행마다 만드는 파일을 두는 폴더. 상대 경로는 상태 폴더(`<works: Folder for the files made for each run. Relative paths are resolved from the state folder (`<workspace>/.state`).
text.이보다 짧은 비밀 값은 실행 기록에서 가리지 않는다(너무 짧으면 오탐이: Secret values shorter than this aren't masked in run history (very short values cause many false matches).
text.실행 백엔드 [연결 테스트]가 기다리는 최대 시간. 요청이 더 길게 달라: Maximum time an execution backend [Test connection] waits. Stops at this value even if the request asks for longer.
Raise this when connection tests keep timing out on a slow network.
text.앱 화면에서 실행 백엔드 계정(예: 구독)에 로그인하는 기능의 시간·표시: Time and display limits for signing in to execution backend accounts (for example a subscription) from the app screen.
Origin name added to records of resumed interrupted runs (not chat turns).
Number of items shown by default in an agent's recent activity list.
text.주소로 바로 연 실행이 어느 프로젝트 기록에 있는지 찾을 때 읽는 등록: Maximum number of registered project records databases read to find which project holds a run opened directly by URL (0 = only projects this server already knows and app records).
text.실행 위치 찾기 프로젝트 수 상한: Projects searched to locate a run
Run event type prefixes the run detail [Observe] tab collects (for example mcp.). Leave empty for the package default; an empty list collects no events in the Observe tab.
text.새 관측 수집기가 다른 접두어로 이벤트를 낼 때 더하거나, 관측 탭을 끌: Add one when a new observation collector emits events with another prefix, or use it to turn off the Observe tab.
text.프로젝트 기능은 켜져 있는데 프로젝트·실행 연동이 꺼졌을 때, 프로젝트를: When the projects feature is on but the projects and runs integration is off: whether to block runs with a project, and the text shown.
text.실행 오류의 해결 버튼 표(JSON, 예: [맨 위 실행 열기]). 비우: Fix button table for run errors (JSON, for example [Open top run]). Leave empty for the default table; no button in the table means no button. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Use this to change the fix button text and target screen, or to turn them off.

codes.runs.storage_memory: There's no database, so run history is kept in memory only (it's lost on restart)
codes.team.rules_unavailable: No module provides the pre-run team rule check (runs.preparers), so runs use engine validation only
